canonical_statement: On a round sphere, among measurable sets of a fixed normalized surface measure, a spherical cap minimizes the normalized surface measure of every closed geodesic neighbourhood.
domain_and_universes: Provisional intended domain: the unit round sphere S^n for a dimension n >= 1, its geodesic metric, Borel sigma-algebra, and normalized Riemannian surface probability measure; Prop in Lean universe 0. Exact mathlib object choices remain for the statement phase.
quantifiers: measurable A contained in the round sphere S^n
spherical cap C with normalized surface measure equal to that of A
conclusion: mu(neighbourhood C r) <= mu(neighbourhood A r)
